measurementRules.rule: First acceptance is after all actual same-configuration mixing, centrifugal casting, punching, curing/hardening, conditioning, blank inspection/rework and required supply packing, ready for supply at the plant. Q (also Q0 or original Qc for cohort c) is independently measured unique first accepted complete-blank net kg, with actual retained resin constituents/water once and measured detachable packaging tare excluded. Initial required packing belongs to new manufacture; later storage/repacking/redelivery/repair/retest is only actual service of the original cohort in H. Actual count-to-mass uses independently measured same-configuration M with sampling/uncertainty, never a catalogue blank weight.

Each externally prepared resin, initiator or accelerator formulation is purchased once as the whole supply; assay, active ingredient and carrier water are nonadditive subaccounts. Actual site compounding instead records each separately purchased material with actual mixing energy and losses.

Keep original native units and actual states. Integrate only true measured rates; an integrated gas/liquid volume receives no extra time multiplier. Volume-to-mass uses independently measured density of that substance at actual composition/T/P, never water density for solvent, resin, effluent or gas. Convert measured electricity kWh to MJ by3.6 before allocation.

measurementRules.rule: Protocols collect raw undivided amounts. convert_raw, trace_cohort and select_denominator precede report_once; cards and aggregation only reference that single result. For Q or Qc nonpositive retain all actual loads and inherited vectors without unit results; do not delete the failed period or force a pass for unknown relationships.

calculationRules.rule: Convert each raw amount to its native row unit before attribution. kWh * 3.6 = MJ. Integrate genuine rates once; do not integrate an already integrated volume. Use independent same-state density or same-configuration measured blank M only where needed; preserve raw value/unit, conversion and uncertainty.

Preserve full gross physical V separately from attributable A. Assign dedicated exchanges then subdivide, identify exchange-specific determining physical causality, and allocate only genuinely residual common-gate burdens by comparable actual-state market value. Trace each raw/non-WIP/WIP/FG/return vector through opening and closing history; already-net amounts are not adjusted twice.

D_r = Q for a new first-release cohort or D_r = original Qc for actual subsequent services/physical movements. Q and Qc are net first-release kg, never gross shipment or service observation H. When D_r is nonpositive retain actual raw loads and do not emit a unit result. No repeat release from dispatch, reinspection or return.

x_r = N_r / D_r. Physical cards use full gross V_r as N_r; utility/service burden cards use traced A_r. D_r is the positive cohort release kg from select_denominator. Divide once after raw conversion and real attribution; card amounts and protocol aggregation reference x_r without another division. The actual provider rows upr_supply/mekp_supply/cobalt_supply/styrene_supply/wax_supply/acetone_supply/water_supply and each _burden row select actual compatible attributable A_r as N_r. Gross physical/waste/air-exit rows retain complete V_r; actual compatible provider-service demand is assigned separately without overlap and is never purchased again merely because a physical leg is disclosed.

For each actual polyethylene-film liner or corrugated-carton whole wet pool in kg, verify O + P + I + ERin + J_in + H2O_in - X_in = C + S + EOout + W + J_out + H2O_out - X_out. O/C include empty, WIP-attached, FG-attached, returned and reusable physical stocks; P is fresh purchase, I real supplier-included receipt, ERin external return received inward, S gross shipment outward, EOout external return sent outward, and W the actual whole wet waste exit. Paired internal reuse cancels on consolidation; it is neither ERin nor EOout nor procurement. Actual supplier-included packaging has one complete upstream owner and is never bought again. J_in/J_out are independently evidenced disjoint additional non-water transfers such as actual retained repair material, dust or oil only where not already included in another whole gross leg. H2O_in/H2O_out are actual sorption/addition/evaporation or other water transfers not already contained in a wet leg. Closing C retains all true additions even without repair. X_in/X_out subtract only proved overlap between OTHER same-side flow observations; never real J/H2O, C, opposite directions, unknown closure differences or card existence. Unknown terms are not fitted. Trace each true increment to its physical source/receiver and specific atomic interface; paired internal J/water is not a new provider or waste exit. Nested water/material in a gross wet leg is counted once. One actual whole cured-scrap, uncured-mixture, spent-acetone, aqueous-waste, contaminated cloth/filter, discarded liner/carton or retired tool/equipment receiver event has complete wet Qt, substrate plus all retained resin/solvent/residue/water once. Nested origin/species/assay masses are not additional exports until actually separated. The actual receiver/provider gets full physical Qt once in its own compatible unit. Separately retain total actual modelling-service demand and nonoverlapping A_e,c for every serviced original Qc or actual new Q. Never reduce physical Qt by an attribution share, add retained solvent/water again, charge full Qt anew to every cohort or infer recycling credit. Unknown A remains unresolved with the complete physical event/history retained. Independently reconcile manufacturing, FG and consolidated full wet physical gates, elements and true reactive species; paired internal first-release/reuse handovers cancel once.

Independently verify Q0 = D0_c + FG0_c + Held0_c + L0_c + T0_c, with disjoint remaining original-material deliveries, released on-site FG, every other actual accepted on-site state, irreversible original material/water losses, and other terminal dispositions. Subdivide those bins for every real location/status; gross delivery/return loops cancel only in this event bridge. Record each original-material fate once on its locked acceptance basis. Independently bridge each surviving present wet mass to original matter still present plus real retained later non-water material and water changes. Do not restore a lost original mass into a survivor and also retain it in L0_c. New material/sorbed water creates physical mass, not new Q. Q0=0 or unknown retains all raw loads and no normalized result.
calculationRules.output: original Q0 and independent present wet states

calculationRules.rule: k = (tracer_spiked - tracer_native) / (tracer_standard - tracer_native); C_expected = k*C_standard + (1-k)*C_native. Retain the actual Method320 printed inconsistency: §9.2.3 equation3 shows tracer_spiked/tracer_standard but calls DF at least10; equation4 uses it as a mixing fraction. Do not copy that incompatible reciprocal convention. This PCR’s explicit independent dimensional synthesis is k=(tracer_spiked-tracer_native)/(tracer_standard-tracer_native) on the same actual molar wet/dry basis, with distinct nonzero endmembers, conservative tracer and 0<k<1; C_expected=k*C_standard+(1-k)*C_native. A reciprocal dilution ratio is1/k and is not substituted for k. Retain actual flows, endmember/background and field recovery evidence; the illustration is not a tracer dose or SF6-use requirement, recipe or performed QA. For spectra use the source’s actual path/temperature/pressure correction; mass emission integrates actual matching-state concentration and gas amount once, never a second time multiplier for an already integrated volume.
inputs: actual same-basis tracer and analyte endmembers

collectionProtocols.collection_method: For actual external styrene, acetone and molecular H2O vapor, EPA Method320 and its included FTIR Protocol provide an independent extractive vapor-phase programme: actual target/reference spectra or Protocol4.6 preparation, spectral/interferant selection including water, appropriate optical/path/T/P conditions, heated nonreactive transport without condensation, leak/linearity/background/CTS checks, complete raw spectra and residual analysis, independent same-basis gas amount/flow and concentration integration, and analyte-specific transport/matrix validation. Follow its distinct routine QA spike and section13 validation/Method301 bias/precision programme; an ordinary spike does not replace initial validation and its result is not an automatic correction factor. No claim of actual site validation or all vapor/all matrix coverage is made. The programme exists; ordinary unperformed site/reference/QA work is a study requirement, while an actually inapplicable or unestablished necessary procedure stays a specific hold. It does not measure crosslinked polymer particles or liquid condensate as gaseous monomer. Retain the actual Method320 printed inconsistency: §9.2.3 equation3 shows tracer_spiked/tracer_standard but calls DF at least10; equation4 uses it as a mixing fraction. Do not copy that incompatible reciprocal convention. This PCR’s explicit independent dimensional synthesis is k=(tracer_spiked-tracer_native)/(tracer_standard-tracer_native) on the same actual molar wet/dry basis, with distinct nonzero endmembers, conservative tracer and 0<k<1; C_expected=k*C_standard+(1-k)*C_native. A reciprocal dilution ratio is1/k and is not substituted for k. Retain actual flows, endmember/background and field recovery evidence; the illustration is not a tracer dose or SF6-use requirement, recipe or performed QA. For spectra use the source’s actual path/temperature/pressure correction; mass emission integrates actual matching-state concentration and gas amount once, never a second time multiplier for an already integrated volume. Method18 is contrary scope evidence, not an unconditional styrene method: §1.2.2 excludes high-molecular-weight polymers, compounds that can polymerize before analysis, and very-low-vapor-pressure compounds. Its GC detector programme alone does not close a polymerizing sample’s preservation. Method4 independently distinguishes accurate reference moisture determination from approximate setup estimates and warns of saturated/droplet positive bias; condensed organic-rich liquid is not automatically pure water. Quantitative FTIR water requires its actual Protocol4.6 quantitative reference, not merely a water-interference spectrum. Total VOC, exposure concentration, COD and total PM are not styrene/acetone/polyester species masses. A real polymer-specific particulate claim requires its established identification/recovery/matrix programme; absent that, keep the affected actual claim on hold rather than label all collected PM as UPR. No measured blank-production result follows from any of these method documents.

measurementRules.rule: 首次验收位于同配置全部实际混合、离心浇铸、冲切、固化/硬化、调理、坯检验/返工及必要供货包装完成、工厂可供货之时。Q（亦记Q0或原队列c的Qc）为独立实测的唯一首次完整纽扣坯验收净kg，包含实际留存树脂成分和水一次，排除实测可拆包装皮重。首次必要包装归新增制造，后续留库/重包/再交付/修理/复检仅是H内原队列真实服务。件数转质量仅用独立实测同配置M及抽样/不确定性，不用目录坯重。
每份外部配制树脂、引发剂或促进剂按整份供货采购一次；含量、活性物及载水为非加和子账。真实厂内配制则逐项记录独立外购材料及实际混合能耗损失。
保留原生单位与真实状态。仅对真实测量速率积分；已积分的气液体积不能再乘时间。体积换质量使用该物质实际组成/温压下独立测得密度，不能把水密度套给溶剂、树脂、废液或气体。实测电力kWh在分配前乘3.6转MJ。

measurementRules.required_property: actual row numerator per original net Mass denominator
measurementRules.rule: 协议采集未除基准的原始量。convert_raw、trace_cohort及select_denominator先于report_once；卡片与aggregation仅引用同一次结果。Q或Qc非正时保留全部真实负荷和继承向量，不出单位结果；不能删除失败期间或把未知关系强称通过。

calculationRules.rule: 各原始量在归属前转换为原生行单位。kWh * 3.6 = MJ。真实速率仅积分一次，已积分体积不再积分。仅在需要时采用独立同状态密度或同配置实测坯料M；保留原值/单位、转换及不确定性。
完整毛实物V与归属A分别保留。先归专属交换，再细分、识别逐交换决定性物理因果关系，仅对真正共同门剩余负荷按可比实际状态市场价值分配。逐项追溯原料/非WIP/WIP/FG/返回向量的期初期末历史；已净额数量不能二次调整。
新首次放行批次的D_r = Q；后续真实服务/实物流转的D_r = 原Qc。Q及Qc为首次放行净kg，不是毛发货或服务观察H。D_r非正时保留真实原始负荷，不出单位结果。发运、复验或退回不产生重复放行。

x_r = N_r / D_r。实物卡的N_r为完整毛V_r；公用工程/服务负荷卡采用已追溯A_r。D_r为select_denominator得到的正值批次放行kg。原始换算及真实归属后仅除一次；卡片数量及协议aggregation引用x_r，不能再除。 实际provider行upr_supply/mekp_supply/cobalt_supply/styrene_supply/wax_supply/acetone_supply/water_supply以及各_burden行取实际兼容归属A_r为N_r；各gross实物/废物/气相出口行保留完整V_r，provider需求另按实际兼容服务非重叠归属，不能从物理腿自动再采购。

每个实际聚乙烯膜内衬或瓦楞纸箱整湿池以kg核对O + P + I + ERin + J_in + H2O_in - X_in = C + S + EOout + W + J_out + H2O_out - X_out。O/C包含空包、附着WIP、附着FG、退回及复用实物库存；P为新增采购，I为真实供应商已含接收，ERin为外部退回收进，S为gross对外发运，EOout为对外退还，W为实际整湿废物出口。内部复用配对在合并时抵消，不是ERin、EOout或采购。供应商已含包装具有一个完整上游所有者，不再购买一次。 J_in/J_out为独立实证且互不重叠的额外非水转移，例如真实留存修理料、粉尘或油，仅限尚未包含于其他整gross腿的部分。H2O_in/H2O_out为实际吸湿/加水/蒸发或其他未包含于整湿腿的水转移。期末C保留全部真实增量，即使没有修理。X_in/X_out仅扣OTHER同侧流观测间已证重叠，不扣真实J/H2O、C、反向流、未知闭合差或卡片存在。未知项不拟合。真实增量追到物理来源/接收方及具体原子接口；配对内部J/水不是新增provider或废物出口。gross湿腿内含的水/物料只计一次。 实际固化边角料、未固化混合物、废丙酮、含水废物、污染擦布/过滤件、废内衬/纸箱或退役工具/设备的一次整件接收事件保留完整湿Qt，基材加全部留存树脂/溶剂/残留/水仅一次。嵌套来源/物种/检验质量不是额外出口，除非真实分离。实际receiver/provider按其兼容单位一次接收全部实物Qt。另保留实际建模服务总需求及各受服务原Qc或真实新增Q的非重叠A_e,c。不按归属份额缩Qt，不另加留存溶剂/水，不向各队列重新计全部Qt，也不推再生抵扣。A未知保持未解，完整实物事件/历史保留。 制造/FG/合并完整湿实物门及元素/真实反应物种另独立核对；内部首次放行及复用交接配对抵消。

独立核对Q0 = D0_c + FG0_c + Held0_c + L0_c + T0_c，各项分别为互不重叠的尚存原物料交付、现场已放行FG、全部其他实际现场已验收状态、原物料/水不可逆损失和其他终端去向。按每个真实地点/状态继续细分；gross交付/退回循环仅在此事件桥中抵消。各原物料去向在锁定验收基准下仅记一次。另将各幸存制品当前湿质量桥接到仍在其中的原物料以及后续真实留存非水物料和水变化。不将原损失恢复进幸存物后又记入L0_c。新料/吸湿增加实物质量，不增加Q。Q0=0或未知保留全部原始负荷且无归一化结果。
calculationRules.output: original Q0 and independent present wet states

calculationRules.rule: k = (tracer_spiked - tracer_native) / (tracer_standard - tracer_native); C_expected = k*C_standard + (1-k)*C_native. 保留Method320真实印刷矛盾：第9.2.3节式3写tracer_spiked/tracer_standard，却称DF至少10，式4又将其作为混合分数。不照抄不兼容量纲的倒数约定。本PCR明确独立量纲综合为同一真实摩尔湿/干基准上k=(tracer_spiked-tracer_native)/(tracer_standard-tracer_native)，要求不同且非零差的端元、守恒示踪物及0<k<1；C_expected=k*C_standard+(1-k)*C_native。倒数稀释比为1/k，不能替k。保留实际流量、端元/背景及现场回收证据，算例不规定示踪剂量、SF6使用、配方或已执行QA。光谱采用来源真实光程/温度/压力校正；排放质量只积分一次实际同状态浓度与气量，已积分体积不再乘时间。
inputs: actual same-basis tracer and analyte endmembers

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 对实际外部苯乙烯、丙酮和分子H2O蒸气，EPA Method320及所含FTIR Protocol提供独立抽取式气相程序：真实目标/参考光谱或Protocol4.6制备、含水等光谱/干扰选择、合适光路/T/P条件、不冷凝的加热惰性输送、漏检/线性/背景/CTS检查、完整原始光谱及残差分析、独立同基准气量/流量与浓度积分，以及分析物特定输送/基质验证。遵守不同的例行QA加标和第13节验证/Method301偏差精密度程序，普通加标不替代初次验证，其结果不是自动校正因子。不声称现场实际验证或全部蒸气/基质覆盖。程序确实存在，未执行现场/参考/QA工作属于研究要求；实际不适用或未建立的必要程序仍具体hold。不把交联聚合物粒子或液体冷凝物当气相单体测量。 保留Method320真实印刷矛盾：第9.2.3节式3写tracer_spiked/tracer_standard，却称DF至少10，式4又将其作为混合分数。不照抄不兼容量纲的倒数约定。本PCR明确独立量纲综合为同一真实摩尔湿/干基准上k=(tracer_spiked-tracer_native)/(tracer_standard-tracer_native)，要求不同且非零差的端元、守恒示踪物及0<k<1；C_expected=k*C_standard+(1-k)*C_native。倒数稀释比为1/k，不能替k。保留实际流量、端元/背景及现场回收证据，算例不规定示踪剂量、SF6使用、配方或已执行QA。光谱采用来源真实光程/温度/压力校正；排放质量只积分一次实际同状态浓度与气量，已积分体积不再乘时间。 Method18是相反范围证据，不是无条件苯乙烯方法：第1.2.2节排除高分子聚合物、可能在分析前聚合的化合物及极低蒸气压化合物，仅有GC检测器程序不能闭合可聚合样品的保全。Method4独立区分准确参考水分测定和设备设定近似估计，并提示饱和/液滴正偏差，含有机物冷凝液不能自动算纯水。FTIR定量水要求真实Protocol4.6定量参考，不能仅用水干扰光谱。总VOC、暴露浓度、COD及总PM不是苯乙烯/丙酮/聚酯物种质量。真实聚合物特定颗粒主张须有已建立的识别/回收/基质程序，缺失时将受影响真实主张保持hold，不把全部收集PM贴为UPR。这些方法文件均不提供已测纽扣坯生产结果。

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 这里固化为供货UPR制剂真实自由基交联，不凭假定变成现场新聚酯缩聚。实际单体结合、留存未反应单体、蒸发、引发剂分解及各真实物种生成/消耗，独立于总湿质量和元素守恒。各反应分子物种记录期初 + 实际输入 + 独立实证生成 = 期末 + 实际输出 + 独立实证消耗，不把已固化聚合物当未改变苯乙烯单体守恒，也不强加缩合水。含挥发物整废物和收集冷凝液保持整件实物接收。实际试样完整性、硬化及可加工性验收采用机械/买方证据，不编残余单体化学限值、统一硬度或时间/温度。若真实等级要求化学检验，其真实基质特定程序须存在后才完成该主张。 对实际外部苯乙烯、丙酮和分子H2O蒸气，EPA Method320及所含FTIR Protocol提供独立抽取式气相程序：真实目标/参考光谱或Protocol4.6制备、含水等光谱/干扰选择、合适光路/T/P条件、不冷凝的加热惰性输送、漏检/线性/背景/CTS检查、完整原始光谱及残差分析、独立同基准气量/流量与浓度积分，以及分析物特定输送/基质验证。遵守不同的例行QA加标和第13节验证/Method301偏差精密度程序，普通加标不替代初次验证，其结果不是自动校正因子。不声称现场实际验证或全部蒸气/基质覆盖。程序确实存在，未执行现场/参考/QA工作属于研究要求；实际不适用或未建立的必要程序仍具体hold。不把交联聚合物粒子或液体冷凝物当气相单体测量。 Method18是相反范围证据，不是无条件苯乙烯方法：第1.2.2节排除高分子聚合物、可能在分析前聚合的化合物及极低蒸气压化合物，仅有GC检测器程序不能闭合可聚合样品的保全。Method4独立区分准确参考水分测定和设备设定近似估计，并提示饱和/液滴正偏差，含有机物冷凝液不能自动算纯水。FTIR定量水要求真实Protocol4.6定量参考，不能仅用水干扰光谱。总VOC、暴露浓度、COD及总PM不是苯乙烯/丙酮/聚酯物种质量。真实聚合物特定颗粒主张须有已建立的识别/回收/基质程序，缺失时将受影响真实主张保持hold，不把全部收集PM贴为UPR。这些方法文件均不提供已测纽扣坯生产结果。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 原始记录; 校准; 独立分析及不确定性

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 制造、FG、合并实物门及每个继承交换向量分别闭合。保留原料、WIP、未使用非WIP及历史FG区别；混合W仅一个总量/供方，来源不加和。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整库存事件向量; 包装池; 接收方及实物物种记录

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 来源支持真实坯料终端及选定浇片路线的透明定性技术综合；不是同一SKU、工厂订单、产率范围、当代排放实测或分配审批。保留相关替代路线及来源限制。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整原件上下文; 各来源适用性判断
